name: zeroship
description: zeroship monorepo root — pnpm workspace for packages/ and examples/.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter zeroship-migrate-node build && pnpm --filter @zeroship/migrate build && pnpm --filter zero-migrate-cli build && pnpm --filter @zeroship/db build && pnpm build:data-v8-adapter && pnpm -r --filter './packages/*' --filter '!./packages/zero-migrate*' --filter '!@zeroship/db' build
scripts.build:data-v8-adapter: pnpm --dir packages/db exec tsup ../../crates/zeroship-data-v8/js/adapter.ts --format esm --platform neutral --target es2022 --out-dir ../../crates/zeroship-data-v8/dist --clean --external zeroship --no-config
